title: phyllanthus cordatus
intro: Phyllanthus cordatus, commonly known as Bato or Bato Tree, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of P. cordatus include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and hepatoprotective effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of P. cordatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
